items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...then Ernie Anderson started - right? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah - I was doing everything -- man, I was making money and happy as hell--- you know.

ctx.x: And, she had a couple of other shows during the time I was in the Army and then, of course, when I got back, she was doing something else--- so I never did that.

Well, then, when you went into the Army you had already had behind you the Commodore records - they were freshly out--- most of them - there were more to come. You had been playing in the Town Hall concert with Eddie Condon and everybody else - then Ernie Anderson started - right?
Oh, yeah - I was doing everything -- man, I was making money and happy as hell--- you know.
